text:
Served: 8 sushi rolls (salmon/avocado/cucumber), about 40 kcal each, so 320 kcal. One fresh spring roll, about 150 kcal. Cola, about 250 ml at 105 kcal. Wasabi about 5 kcal, soy sauce about 10 kcal. Total served is roughly 590 kcal.

Leftover: about half of the spring roll (75 kcal), a cucumber piece and rice remnants (10 kcal), most of the soy sauce (8 kcal), wasabi (3 kcal) and a little cola (5 kcal). That comes to about 100 kcal.

Eaten: 590 − 100 ≈ 490 kcal.

Macros eaten:
- Sushi: protein 12 g, carbs 56 g, fat 6 g.
- Half spring roll: protein 3 g, carbs 13 g, fat 1.5 g.
- Cola: carbs about 25 g.

Totals are roughly protein 16 g, carbs 95 g and fat 8 g. Calculated from macros this gives 512 kcal, which is close to the 490 estimate.
